$comment: Seeded from the frozen v1 discovery schema at the RFC 0266 §C cut-over (byte-equal to the 2.49.12 derivation); v2-owned since, edited by hand.

scopes.description: Subset of scopes the host implements. Tenant-scoped secrets are workspace-shared; user-scoped are per-end-user; run-scoped are ephemeral per-run; `workspace` (RFC 0046/0048) is the explicit sub-tenant scope. Appended `workspace` is additive — hosts that omit it are unaffected.

resolution.description: Resolution mode. v1.x supports only `host-managed` (clients reference stored secrets via opaque ids); reserved for future modes.

maxEntries.description: The most `{ ref, value }` entries one `createRun` may carry in `runSecrets`.

runSecrets.description: RFC 0229 — the host accepts run-supplied secrets: a top-level `runSecrets` array of `{ ref, value }` on `createRun`, each `ref` in the reserved `run:` namespace, resolvable only by the run that supplied it. Absent means `createRun` does not accept `runSecrets`, and a client MUST NOT send it. A host advertising it MUST also list `run` in `scopes`, MUST execute the node type `core.secret.witness`, and MUST advertise the fixture `openwop-secrets-run-witness`.
